label: first occurrence of j/v/k/h/3 early in the original phase
explanation: Update-gate unit active only during the original input phase (100% of mass; never on <DEL> and essentially never in the copy phase), concentrated in the first five positions (t=0..4; nothing past t=6), with a dip at t=1. It is token-selective: j and v (~30% rate each, ~54% of mass together), then k, h and the digit 3; other tokens give weak, low-magnitude activations. It fires almost only on the first occurrence of the input token in the sequence (98.5% of mass). Strongest activations are j/v at t=2-3 after a prefix containing 0 and/or w (e.g. w 0 [j], w w 0 [v]); prev_tok 0 or w raises the rate. Misses are mostly low-magnitude activations on other tokens; false positives are mostly 3, k or h at t=1 or t=4, where it often stays silent.
